systems.system: AES biometric national identity card enrolment
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Intérieur, de la Sécurité Publique et de l'Administration du Territoire
systems.tiers: Mass enrolment launched 2026-04-25 at the Yantala police commissariat; enrolment centres installed in the twenty commissariats of Niamey, with gradual extension to the whole country planned

note: Police commissariats appear only as enrolment centres for the civil identity card, which no typology class covers; nothing on reports or cases recorded at a station.
